title: Evaluating Package-Level Scoping Strategies for Repository-Level Code Completion in Pharo
abstract: arXiv:2609.20279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Source code is organized in repositories, packages, and projects, yet token-level completion engines rarely exploit this structure. Pharo provides a semantic completion engine based on ordered, lazy heuristics that retrieve and rank candidates. Its default strategy follows language semantics and scoping rules, but ignores package structure and dependencies. Consequently, classes from the same package or project, and classes used by them, receive no special priority.   We introduce and evaluate three package-aware heuristics: Lateral Packages, Direct Package Dependencies, and Two-Level Package Dependencies. Our benchmark covers method call sites from 219 packages, including 4,535 classes and 35,972 methods across major Pharo projects such as Iceberg, Moose, Roassal, Seaside, and Spec. translated_title: 评估Pharo中仓库级代码补全的包级作用域策略
translated_abstract: 源代码以仓库、包和项目的形式组织，然而词元级补全引擎很少利用这种结构。Pharo提供了一个基于有序、惰性启发式规则的语义补全引擎，用于检索和排序候选者。其默认策略遵循语言语义和作用域规则，但忽略了包结构和依赖关系。因此，来自同一包或项目的类，以及它们所使用的类，不会获得特殊的优先级。我们引入并评估了三种包感知启发式策略：横向包、直接包依赖和两级包依赖。我们的基准测试涵盖了来自219个包的方法调用点，包括4,535个类和35,972个方法，涉及Iceberg、Moose、Roassal、Seaside和Spec等主要Pharo项目。我们评估了类名和方法名补全，并探讨显式包依赖是否能够提供一种轻量级的结构信号来改进候选项。
tldr: 该论文提出并评估了三种包感知启发式策略（横向包、直接包依赖和两级包依赖），利用包结构和显式依赖关系作为轻量级结构信号，以提升Pharo仓库级代码补全的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces and evaluates three package-aware heuristics (Lateral Packages, Direct Package Dependencies, and Two-Level Package Dependencies) that leverage package structure and explicit dependencies as a lightweight structural signal to improve repository-level code completion in Pharo.
